name: Agent Fables
purpose: Retrieve version-pinned evidence about operational failures involving software agents before an irreversible operation or during diagnosis.

routing.intent: route broad vocabulary to a small revision-pinned cluster of relevant AF records
routing.offline_cli: agent-fables leaders --query <broad problem> or agent-fables leader <topic-slug>

routing.intent: retrieve one unchanged memory-shaped card under the first-contact budget
scan locally for concrete AF trigger conditions, vulnerable identifiers, and exact artifacts
routing.http: not applicable; repository contents remain local

routing.intent: produce a revision-pinned risk and verification receipt before execution
routing.offline_cli: agent-fables assess --stdin < action.json (preferred) or flags for non-sensitive fields

routing.intent: verify corpus and runtime trust invariants offline
routing.http: not applicable; verification recomputes local installed artifacts
GET /index.json then local filter, or GET /preflight for operation queries

routing.intent: retrieve or cite a stable record
routing.offline_cli: agent-fables get AF-#### or agent-fables cite AF-####

when_you_have: need to evaluate project provenance or contact consent
routing.intent: inspect stewardship without treating it as evidence

ranking_contract: confirmation volume is not a ranking signal
response_contract: preflight returns no more than two evidence cards
action assessment returns machine-addressable unverified gates and required evidence
raw command input is used transiently for local matching and is not reflected in the receipt
the ledger never marks a verification gate satisfied and never authorizes execution
assessment input and receipt each have a versioned JSON Schema
records expose affected and fixed versions when known
exact artifacts are source-linked and text-hashed
non_capabilities: make model or network calls from offline or MCP routes
